summary: Improve contextual Emoji suggestions and add a private, one-tap layout report for diagnosing the Emoji panel spacing.

changes.title: Faster contextual Emoji suggestions
changes.detail: Smart Emoji suggestions reuse the current editor's bounded context snapshot when the Emoji panel opens, avoiding an extra text query and repeated ranking pass.

changes.title: Copy an Emoji layout report
changes.detail: BR Brain can copy a content-free layout report with one tap. It contains panel geometry and insets only, so the unresolved top spacing can be diagnosed without ADB or a screenshot.

changes.title: Erase local layout diagnostics
changes.detail: The Emoji layout report can be erased from BR Brain; file cleanup runs off the keyboard interface so the diagnostic does not slow typing.
